patch.summary: Shopify implementation guide: day-zero sequence, pilot rules, plan gates, and cutover checks from SoftwareGlimpse research — not generic CRM setup filler.

blocks.body: Implement Shopify by mapping current ecommerce workflows to Shopify objects, confirming plan gates for b2b wholesale (Basic, Grow, Advanced, Plus), dropshipping sourcing (Basic, Grow, Advanced, Plus), piloting one team, then cutting over integrations (Stripe, PayPal, Facebook) after data checks.
bullets: Gate check: b2b wholesale (Basic, Grow, Advanced, Plus)
Integrate after: data quality pass on Stripe

blocks.heading: Shopify day-zero to steady-state sequence
blocks.body: Treat Shopify setup as a controlled rollout — not a weekend dump of CSV files.

scenarios.title: Day zero — objects and owners
scenarios.body: Define owners for online storefront, product catalog, checkout payments before inviting the whole org.

scenarios.title: SMB pilot
scenarios.body: One pipeline / one team proves Merchants wanting a hosted store without managing infrastructure before company-wide seats.

scenarios.title: Cutover
scenarios.body: Freeze legacy writes briefly; validate Stripe and PayPal before reopen.

steps.label: Go when plan unlocks cover b2b wholesale (Basic, Grow, Advanced, Plus)
Pause if this limitation blocks ops: Subscription plus apps/themes and payment spreads raise TCO versus headline plan price
Do not expand seats until online storefront is green

items.title: Mistake 1
items.body: Subscription plus apps/themes and payment spreads raise TCO versus headline plan price

items.title: Mistake 2
items.body: Third-party payment gateways incur additional transaction fees on lower tiers

items.title: Mistake 3
items.body: Plus and advanced B2B features require higher plans or add-ons

items.title: Mistake 4
items.body: Heavy customization may need Liquid/dev resources or agency help

items.title: Big-bang invite
items.body: Inviting every user before object design creates junk data that is expensive to unwind.

blocks.title: Shopify plan gates that affect rollout
blocks.body: Implementation fails when unlocks needed for go-live sit on a higher tier than budgeted.

lines.label: Basic
lines.description: 3-day trial · Unlocks: online storefront, product catalog, checkout payments · Suits: teams whose must-have gates appear on this tier

lines.label: Grow
lines.description: 3-day trial · Suits: teams whose must-have gates appear on this tier

lines.description: 3-day trial · Suits: teams whose must-have gates appear on this tier

lines.label: Plus

blocks.title: Validate ecommerce fit before a deep Shopify rollout
blocks.body: If Shopify fails constraint fit, stop implementation early.

checklist.label: Draft Shopify object owners before invites
Confirm plan unlocks for go-live features
Pilot one team on online storefront
If blocked, evaluate BigCommerce before sunk-cost expansion
